make_or_buy_basis: Locally CNC-cut floor-board panels and removable hatches mount to surveyed support rails without trapping wet services.

material_spec.finish_or_protection: sealed cut edges and penetrations, isolated mixed-metal joints, no water-trapping pockets, and floor-covering-compatible prepared face
material_spec.form_factor: CNC-cut numbered boards and flush removable hatches supported continuously at released crossmember/service-rail datums
material_spec.governing_standard: supplier rail floor specification plus project fire/smoke, concentrated/distributed load, fatigue, moisture, slip-interface and toxicity evidence
material_spec.grade_or_part_class: rail-qualified aluminium-honeycomb/composite board candidate with aluminium edge closures, stainless retained hatch hardware, isolating pads and sealed inspection plugs
material_spec.material_family: fire-rated structural floor-board and hatch system
material_spec.nominal_section: board thickness, core/skin schedule, support pitch, edge distance, hatch rebates, service clearances and step transitions fixed by LM3-INT-230 drawings and calculation
material_spec.traceability: board/panel batch, cut nest, edge-seal batch, retained-fastener lot, installed position, datum survey and load-test record

joining_methods: sealed, gasketed, bonded, or clipped interface as supplier envelope requires
process_spec.release_level: SOURCE supplier-controlled process; OSR controls envelope and acceptance evidence

fit_gaps: Structural board selection and the final covering/adhesive combination remain to be frozen.
supplier_anchor.localisation: Use the supplier system for first articles; qualify local board/covering as a complete substrate, adhesive, weld, cove, hatch and fire-tested system rather than swapping one layer.
mandatory_equivalence: same or better released fit, mounting datums, connector keying and service envelope
same or better mass, load, duty-cycle, thermal, electrical and environmental ratings
same or better functional safety, fire, EMC, cybersecurity and applicable rail evidence
documented failure modes, maintenance intervals, spares and obsolescence route
first-article inspection plus component, subassembly and vehicle regression tests
signed design-authority substitution record preserving the original anchor and evidence hashes
supplier_anchor.release_boundary: A web page is not a purchase specification. Design authority must freeze the exact supplier part number, configuration, drawings, software, evidence, commercial terms and spares through RFQ before release. Safety-critical substitutes require calculation, test, independent assessment and authority acceptance.

title: stepped floor-board and removable service-hatch system
